note: In the two paratype nests from Ilha Grande the soldiers are distinctly larger, and the original gives the measurements of the two series separately. The species name honours the collector H. Sick.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text:
Compared with G. angustus the alate of this species has a wider head and wider and longer wings and pronotum, and antennae of 13 segments (the latter 12); compared with G. asperatus the head and pronotum are wider, the tibiae shorter, the wings longer and the number of antennal segments different; compared with G. adamsoni the head is darker, the eyes larger, the ocelli smaller, the wings longer and wider, and the pronotum wider; compared with G. marlatti the head is darker and larger and the wings and pronotum longer and wider; compared with G. perparvus the head is larger, the pronotum wider, the wings longer and wider, and the antennae 13-segmented (the latter 11—12). Compared with G. adamsoni the soldier has a less prominent frontal lobe, a shallower and narrower median frontal notch, a labrum whose anterior margin is not evenly rounded, a shallower concavity of the anterior margin of the pronotum, narrower anterolateral corners, and less blunt posterolateral margins.

The type locality is Ilha Grande, Rio de Janeiro state, Brazil (about 22°59′—23°7′ S, 44°7′—44°26′ W); the dealate adults (morphotype and paramorphotypes) and the soldier holotype were collected by H. Muth and H. Sick on 16 October 1944 (month 10), number 516; there are several further series of paratypes, collected on 11 June, 26 June, 10 October and 16 October 1944 (month 6, month 6, month 10 and month 10).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text:
Dealate individuals. Head chestnut brown, with two pale spots on each side of the frons and a pale V-shaped mark in the middle; pronotum bright yellow; legs and labrum pale yellow; antennae brown; nota yellowish brown; wings smoky, the wing scales smoky brown. Head with a few sparse erect setae; margins and disc of the pronotum with both long and short setae; tibiae densely covered with short hairs. Head length (to the base of the mandibles) about equal to the head width. Y-suture faintly visible. Eyes shaped as figured. Ocelli small, slightly oval, touching the eyes. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 3 longer than or equal to segment 4. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, anterior margin concave, sides rounded, posterior margin slightly concave. The media of the hindwing arises from the radial sector beyond the wing scale, about 0.53—0.68 mm from the wing suture.

Measurements of 11 alates: head length (to the tip of the labrum) 0.98—1.05 mm; head length (to the base of the mandibles) 0.83—0.90 mm; head width 0.82—0.90 mm; diameter of the eye 0.25—0.29 mm; distance from the lower margin of the eye 0.09—0.11 mm; length of the ocellus 0.07 mm; pronotum median length 0.45—0.53 mm; pronotum maximum length 0.54—0.66 mm; pronotum width 0.71—0.83 mm; length of the hind tibia 0.64—0.72 mm; length of the forewing from the wing suture 4.87—4.95 mm; width of the forewing 1.35—1.50 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head yellowish brown, the frontal region reddish brown; mandibles dark reddish brown; pronotum pale yellow; antennae, legs and labrum pale yellow; nota nearly white. Head with a few sparse erect short setae; margins and disc of the pronotum with both long and short setae. Head small and thick (the soldiers of the two paratype nests from Ilha Grande are larger); sides converging anteriorly; frontal face nearly vertical in lateral view, with a slope of about 50° in the middle; bilobed, with a deep median notch. Mandibles short, with a very weak swelling on the outer base; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the base of the first narrow and the bases of the second and third broad; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the tip of the first marginal tooth lying 0.21—0.25 mm from the tip of the apical tooth. Postmentum shaped as figured, slightly constricted in the middle, with a very small tubercle on the anterior part in lateral view. Antennae 10-segmented, segment 3 the shortest, segment 4 shorter than segment 2. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, anterior margin broadly angular, anterolateral corners narrow, sides straight and converging posteriorly, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle. Femora moderately swollen.

Soldier measurements (holotype; paratypes from the type nest n=3; the other series of paratypes n=6): head length (to the base of the mandibles) 1.13 mm / 1.05—1.13 mm / 1.38—1.53 mm; head width 0.88 mm / 0.83—0.90 mm / 1.01—1.08 mm; head height 0.81 mm / 0.77—0.83 mm / 0.98—1.01 mm; length of the left mandible 0.61 mm / 0.61 mm / 0.68 mm; postmentum maximum width 0.34 mm / 0.32—0.34 mm / 0.38—0.39 mm; postmentum minimum width 0.26 mm / 0.26 mm / 0.26—0.30 mm; postmentum length 0.60 mm / 0.60—0.67 mm / 0.75—0.83 mm; pronotum median length 0.36 mm / 0.36—0.38 mm / 0.45—0.53 mm; pronotum maximum length 0.45 mm / 0.45—0.53 mm / 0.60 mm; pronotum width 0.77 mm / 0.75—0.79 mm / 0.98—1.08 mm; length of the hind tibia 0.43 mm / 0.43—0.46 mm / 0.68—0.72 mm.
